landing.heroTitle: Stop losing money to uncontrolled attendance
landing.heroSubtitle: B-Attend gives you one dashboard for attendance, shift scheduling, approvals, and payroll-ready reports — built for operational teams everywhere.
landing.oneDashboard: One dashboard for attendance, shifts, approvals, and reports
landing.trustedBy: Trusted by restaurants, cafes, retail chains, gyms, clinics, warehouses, and security companies across Egypt and MENA.
landing.costDesc1: Late arrivals, buddy punching, manual timesheets, and scattered shift data cost you money every single day.
landing.costDesc2: B-Attend replaces all of that with geofenced clock-in/out, real-time visibility, and automated approvals — so you can focus on running your business.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to control attendance
landing.feature1Desc: Employees can only clock in when they're physically at the branch. GPS tracking and geofence radius ensure accuracy.
landing.feature2Desc: Create shift policies, assign schedules, and let the system track late arrivals, early leaves, and overtime automatically.
landing.feature3Desc: Manual punches, overtime requests, and leave requests go through a structured approval flow with full audit trail.
landing.feature4Desc: Employee profiles, contracts, documents, leave balances, warnings, training, and payroll-ready reports — all in one place.
landing.feature5Desc: Daily motivational content, employee performance coaching, and manager insights — powered by AI.
landing.feature6Desc: Manage multiple branches from one dashboard. See live attendance across all locations in real time.
landing.pricingDesc: Start with a free trial. Upgrade when you're ready. No hidden fees.
landing.faq1Q: How does the free trial work?
landing.faq1A: You get 14 days of full access to all features. No credit card required. Cancel anytime.
landing.faq2Q: Can I use B-Attend for multiple branches?
landing.faq2A: Yes! B-Attend is built for multi-branch operations. Manage all your locations from one dashboard.
landing.faq3A: B-Attend works as a mobile web app. Employees can clock in/out from their phones without installing anything.
landing.faq4A: Yes! B-Attend supports both English and Arabic with full RTL layout support.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to take control of attendance?
landing.ctaSubtitle: Start your free trial today. No credit card required.

features.title: Every feature operational teams need
features.subtitle: From mobile clock-in to payroll export — all in one platform, no add-ons.
features.readyToStartDesc: Start your 14-day trial or talk to our sales team.
features.mobileClockInDesc: Employees clock via mobile-friendly web page. Browser geolocation captures lat/long on every punch.
features.gpsGeofenceDesc: Each branch has a configurable radius. Distance is calculated via Haversine and saved in meters.
features.branchKioskDesc: Tablet at the entrance. Employees enter PIN, see their shift, and clock in seconds.
features.antiFakeDesc: Placeholders for mock-location detection, device fingerprinting, and impossible-travel detection.
features.shiftPoliciesDesc: Define start/end, break, late grace, early-leave grace, overtime threshold, weekend days.
features.overnightDesc: Shifts crossing midnight (e.g. 17:00 → 01:00) calculate worked minutes correctly.
features.bulkScheduleDesc: Select branch, employees, date range, shift policy, weekend/off days. Skips duplicates.
features.approvalWorkflowDesc: Manual clock-in/out, missing clock-out, outside geofence, overtime, leave, permission requests.
features.dailyAttendanceDesc: Real rows from AttendanceDay with status, late/early-leave minutes, overtime, exception flags.
features.monthlySummaryDesc: Per-employee totals: present/absent/leave/off days, late minutes, worked hours, overtime.
features.exceptionsOvertimeDesc: Filter rows that require approval, or where overtimeMinutes > 0 (even after approval).
features.csvExportDesc: UTF-8 BOM for Arabic. Proper escaping of quotes, commas, newlines. Respects filters.
features.rolesPermissionsDesc: Company Owner, HR Admin, Branch Manager, Employee. Capability-based, enforced server-side.
features.tenantIsolationDesc: Strict companyId scoping on every query. Branch managers see only their assigned branch.
features.auditLogDesc: Tenant-scoped audit for operational actions. Platform-scoped audit for super admin actions.
features.subscriptionBillingDesc: Trial, Starter, Growth, Pro, Enterprise. Manual activation, invoices, payments, grace periods.
features.superAdminDesc: Internal team manages tenants, plans, subscriptions, invoices, leads, support, audit.
features.notificationsDesc: Alerts for approvals, exceptions, trial ending. Email & WhatsApp placeholders for later phases.
features.customerSettingsDesc: Geofence radius, grace minutes, overtime threshold, mobile/kiosk toggles, approval rules.
features.complianceReadyDesc: Consent placeholders for location tracking. Data retention settings. No biometric storage in MVP.
